context: Part 2 (PR #748) reaps build folders only in agent trees idle 30 minutes or more, and keeps them while a process runs there (#720). The lane chose that a Claude agent's lock does not keep build folders; any other lock does. Reason: the harness locks every agent tree with the live host process for the whole session, so honouring that lock would keep every build folder until the session ends, which is the full-disk failure. Reverting is one commit (ca841732).

options.gain: No full-disk failure from session-long locks.
options.how: Idle 30 minutes and no live process in the tree: the build folders go, lock or not.
options.label: As built: an agent lock does not keep them
options.lose: A resumed agent idle 30 minutes rebuilds from nothing.

options.how: Revert commit ca841732: any lock keeps the tree's build folders.
options.label: An agent lock keeps them
options.lose: Build folders pile up until the session ends; the disk can fill again.

ref: c157 (cleanup never deletes a live agent's build folders), part 2, PR #748
reply: Answered 11:45 CST Nov 13: a, accepted pick ("As built: an agent lock does not keep them"). Home: item c157, part 2, PR #748. Undo: reopen this item.
title: Does a Claude agent's lock keep its build folders from cleanup?
why: It is the change that fixes the full-disk failure; the 30-minute clock already covers a short pause.
